value.reason: The model field in models/user.ts:109-112 holds an authentication secret. The data flow shows totpSecret, and deluxeToken is also written through UserModel.create in data/datacreator.ts. The field is a plain DataTypes.STRING with defaultValue ''. It has no setter, hook or encryption wrapper, so it matches the positive SEC-02 example rather than the negative one that encrypts in set(). The secret is stored as plaintext in the SQLite file data/juiceshop.sqlite. The Terraform evidence does not fix this. EFS encryption is set by var.efs_encrypted, and nothing shown proves that value is true. Even if it were, disk encryption only protects the stored volume. Anyone who can reach the database or its backups would still read the TOTP secret in clear text. A TOTP secret must be recoverable to verify codes, so it cannot be hashed and should be encrypted at the field level. One supporting point is uncertain: routes/authenticatedUsers.ts spreads user.dataValues into a JSON response, but the excerpt is cut off, so it is unclear whether totpSecret is masked afterwards. The storage finding holds either way.
